answer: A farm of fake identities must fund every bond from scarce capital, so fabricating a thousand participants costs a thousand times more than one honest agent. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a ferrous-token bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers randomly audit attestations across epochs. Like layered shale resisting erosion, this bond barrier hardens the network, while honest agents grazing a shared meadow of rewards earn returns no sybil swarm can cheaply match. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
